spec_match.rationale: Models what a controlled-frame integration would surface (labelled 'models the security info structure so you can prototype'); the code sample's details.getSecurityInfo shape is a simplification of the draft API.

interactive.rationale: Endpoint buttons swap realistic simulated readouts (validation/CT/protocol pills); CDP click on expired.example rendered the expired/bad rows correctly.

edge_cases.rationale: Good, bad-chain, expired and weak-TLS endpoints covered.

references.rationale: chromestatus link added to see-also (was missing — invariant 3).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Mobile 360x740 DPR3 scrollWidth now 360 (was 379 — 19px pill clip); grid columns now minmax-based with a shrinkable middle column; desktop CDP interaction verified; screenshots read; console clean except environmental fonts request.

design_system.rationale: Variables incl. the design-system --accent-amber for warn pills.

accessibility.rationale: Endpoint buttons are native and labelled, but pill status is colour+short-text only in a fixed column; a fuller text equivalent per row would help SR users.

openQuestions.title: Give pills accessible text beyond the class word
openQuestions.detail: The third grid column renders the pill class ('ok'/'warn'/'bad') as its only text; expanding to e.g. 'valid', 'legacy', 'failed' with a visually-hidden field context would read better in a screen reader.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table horizontal scroll container mobile overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide content scrolls in its own overflow:auto container; min-width:0 / overflow-wrap on flex-grid items with long unbreakable strings; flex-wrap where overflow is possible.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped wide tables/readouts in dedicated overflow-x:auto containers (tabindex=0, labelled region) or added min-width:0 + overflow-wrap:anywhere to grid/flex value cells; page scrollWidth measured 360 at 360px viewport after the fix.

summary: Added the missing chromestatus reference link (invariant 3) and fixed the 19px mobile clip by making the readout grid columns shrinkable (minmax + overflow-wrap) so pills stay inside the 360px viewport. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via raw CDP (trusted Input.dispatchMouseEvent clicks, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile + 1280x800 desktop emulation, screenshots read) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so 145-only success paths were validated on their honest fallback branches. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental and not counted against the page.
